prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1360; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, so just note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas. I was moving over to the right lane because I needed to make my exit.

Q: What happened as you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and it looked clear, so I signaled and started to move over. Then a vehicle on my right came up alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jerk toward the shoulder.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not really. It was in my blind spot, I think. I didn't see it until the impact.

Q: Were you able to stop safely afterward?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. Both cars were still drivable, so we exchanged information there.

Q: Have you been seen for any injuries?

A: Yes. My neck and upper back started hurting within a few hours. The pain got worse the next morning, and I have stiffness when I turn my head. I've been told I have whiplash.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?

A: I'm going to physical therapy and taking prescribed medication for the pain. I've also had to take time off work because it's hard to sit at a desk for long.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully and I'm hoping this gets resolved so I can get my treatment covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
